To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the exact or sampling error free bootstrap variances of AUC-based accuracy indices can be computed directly without sampling the original data and without the need to compute the AUC itself.
the exact ideal bootstrap variances of AUCs can be computed directly and that the corresponding bootstrap variances can be estimated with negligible sampling errors.

(1) the ideal bootstrap variance of the nonparametrical estimator of the AUC can be calculated exactly without resorting to MC sampling; (2) the exact formulas can be used to improve the accuracy of the AUC-based inferences by eliminating the MC approximation error; and (3) the exact formulas provide an analytical tool for assessing the properties of various bootstrap variance estimators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the accuracy and efficiency of bootstrap methods used to estimate the variances of AUC-based summary statistics.
the derivation of a computationally efficient method for computing the exact bootstrap variances of AUCs.
the exact bootstrap variances for AUCs and the related summary indices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is a valuable tool in the assessment of the AUC-based indices and their variability.
the proposed approach provides the most accurate bootstrap estimates of the variance of AUC-based summary indices, and it is also the most computationally efficient.
the proposed method should be considered as a standard tool for computing the bootstrap variance of the nonparamtric AUC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be implemented with ease and is a useful alternative to the existing MC methods for the estimation of bootstrap variances of AUCs.
the exact bootstrap variances of AUC are computable and the corresponding MC bootstrap estimators are not needed.
the proposed method is a simple, accurate, and computationally efficient tool for computing bootstrap variances of AUC and related indices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a given dataset, the ideal bootstrap variances can be computed exactly without resampling and without the associated sampling error.
, for the AUC and related indices, the ideal bootstrap variance can be computed directly from the data and the ideal bootstrap variance estimators can be computed without resampling the data.

the exact bootstrap variances of AUC-based summary indices can be obtained directly and with no additional sampling error, and that this can be done for both the AUC and the AUC-based index corresponding to a single reader or to an average over a group of readers.
